title: every not-PROVED ticket's plan migrates to the shape the cast door admits, its trail moved whole to its log
intention: Every ticket that is not PROVED carries a plan the cast door admits: only what a builder builds from, with its trail moved whole to its log and its by-lines gone.
why: Akien, 2026-11-14, on d421051bc1f7: "a ticket shouldn't look like that. it's 3 parts, a metadata and a build plan. this kind of stuff is all supposed to be history. and all tickets were supposed to migrate to that format." Measured the same day: 79 of 276 open tickets fail transitions._shape_lacks, and 62 carry 165 trail-like decision lines.
traces_to: Law 5: the address carries what a mind needs now. Outline 3.3.2: the plan holds only what a builder builds from, and the history is the log.
how: One migration module in the rehearsal machine, beside retire. For each ticket whose workflow_and_state does not carry [PROVED], it moves every trail line to the log whole (decision_retired) and removes it from the plan. It drops each decision's `by` onto the log, and parses a numbered prose falsifier into clauses. It never invents bounds or measured. It returns a report naming each ticket's remaining shape lacks. retire's author tooth goes, per Q#96. d421051bc1f7 is rebuilt first, by hand, as the worked example. The live run is one command after PROVED.

clauses.claim: after the run, every open ticket in a scratch commons passes transitions._shape_lacks, or the report names it with exactly the lacks _shape_lacks returns
no open plan carries a decision whose text opens with a fold, MEASURED, SETTLES, re-point or superseded marker, and no decision carries `by`
every moved line and every dropped `by` stands verbatim in its ticket's log, read back through ticket_log.read_log
every PROVED ticket's plan, state and log files are byte-identical before and after the run
a second run moves nothing and writes nothing
retire accepts a line whose `by` differs from the retirer's, so the 'not yours to retire' lack is gone

decisions.text: D1: plan_migration.migrate(root) walks <root>/tickets, skips any ticket whose state or plan workflow_and_state carries [PROVED], and writes each changed plan through rehearsal._write_ticket, never write_text.

D2: a trail line is a decision whose text, case-folded, opens with a fold marker, MEASURED, SETTLES, re-point or superseded. Each moves whole to the log as kind decision_retired via ticket_log.append_log, and is then removed from the plan.
D3: each remaining decision's `by` is logged (kind field, body {n, by}) and removed from the plan.
D4: a prose falsifier is split into clauses only when its numbering runs 1..k. Otherwise it stays as it is, and the report names it.
D5: migrate returns {ticket_id: [lacks]} from transitions._shape_lacks after the run, for every open ticket still lacking.
D6: _retire_lacks loses its author check, per outline 9.3.5.1.1 (Q#96), and the rehearsal charter's public_interface names migrate.
D7: the proof copies a fixture commons (open shaped, open trail-bearing, open prose-falsifier and PROVED tickets) into a scratch root, runs migrate twice, and has one tooth per clause.

out: the live commons (the live run is a separate command after PROVED)
the owning intentions of big-decision prose (named in the report, not written)

measured.saw: 276 open tickets, 771 PROVED; 79 open fail _shape_lacks; 62 open carry 165 trail-like decision lines; d421051bc1f7 alone has 65 lacks
measured.how: a scratch script over origin/main's CairnCommons/tickets calling transitions._shape_lacks with the store charter, and a marker regex over decision text
